About these 37 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday has the most, with 10. The earliest start is Sunday Social Ride at 6:00 am; the latest is Tuesday Night Ride (TNR) at 8:45 pm. After work, 10 roll on a weekday evening. Beginners are welcome on 13 of them. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 1 for women, trans and femme riders, 1 for BIPOC riders, 1 for families and 1 for adaptive riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
